_note: Gemini CLI's hook system is newer than Claude Code / Codex CLI's and event names can vary by version. This config uses AfterTool and SessionEnd, which matched the docs at build time — if your installed CLI calls its turn-end event something else, check `gemini hooks list` and update the key below. hooks/gemini_adapter.py also double-checks the event name from the payload itself at runtime as a second line of defense, so a version mismatch here fails safe (the event is just ignored) rather than crashing.
